messages.content: Vaccines cause autism, I've read it everywhere.

That claim has been thoroughly investigated and the original 1998 study that suggested a link was retracted due to serious ethical violations and data fraud. Dozens of large-scale studies involving millions of children have found no connection between vaccines and autism.
